name: delayed-owner
fault_schedule: Exact reservation metadata release, wrong incarnation, expired pause, one-shot terminal preservation.
assertions: Expired or mismatched release cannot reach Build.
Later reservations cannot overwrite the terminal first reservation receipt.
Dispatch must increase after observing the exact recovered READY generation and incarnation; pre-fence increments cannot satisfy recovery.
limitations: Component controls only; actual runtime delayed-owner mode NOT_EXECUTED.
